as_told.title: Jeremy Corbell's claim of a pyramid-shaped NHI power source drawing for ODNI

plain: Dylan Borland, a former Air Force intelligence specialist who says he saw a triangle-shaped craft, is said to have drawn not only the triangle but also a pyramid-shaped power source in his classified testimony to the ICIG, the inspector general's office that takes whistleblower complaints for the US intelligence agencies. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells this on the show, relaying what he heard, with the journalist George Knapp also named in the account. Michels later repeats it to Borland himself, telling it second-hand from Corbell's appearance, saying Corbell talked about a pyramid structure as the power source. If true, it would mean Borland gave investigators details of how such a craft is powered.
